title: Russell Brand appears in a London court for trial on rape and sexual assault charges - AP News
description: Comedian Russell Brand has appeared in a London court for the opening of his trial on charges of rape and sexual assault. Brand, 51, has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault. The offense…

title: Kelly Clarkson says a Brooklyn store snubbed her. The shop says the item she wanted wasn’t for sale. - NBC News
description: Clarkson blasted Art of Play, alleging it treated her like she “couldn’t afford” its merchandise. The store says the resulting backlash was “surreal.”

title: Magic Johnson makes rare critical post after Commanders' head-scratching tie against Giants - Fox News
description: Magic Johnson expressed disbelief over the Washington Commanders' clock management blunder in their overtime tie against the New York Giants.
